$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (sources-route-distance-and-rdw-lookup D3). Seeds the DORMANT `route-planner-tomtom` source that OCA\Integriq\Service\RouteDistanceService asks for the road distance between two postcodes (GET /1/calculateRoute/{lat,lon}:{lat,lon}/json?travelMode=...). configuration.routeProvider 'tomtom' selects that request shape. To go live: create a credential named tomtom-routing for your TomTom API key, link the app's route planner connection to this source, and enable it.

objects.name: TomTom route planner
objects.description: Answers the road distance between two places, for example for a commuting allowance. Create a credential named tomtom-routing for your API key, link the app's route planner connection to this source and enable it.
